Dadachanji Group Re-enters Pharma Packaging with Kaisha Pharma

The Dadachanji Group has launched Kaisha Pharma, marking its re-entry into the pharmaceutical glass packaging sector. The group has made an initial investment of 45 million euros to establish and scale up operational capabilities. Kaisha Pharma is intended to adopt a more global approach compared to the group's previous India-focused operations.
